resources.string: These details come from the account opened with that service. They stay sealed on this phone.
Any service with WebDAV works. These are only suggestions, and their terms may change.
Some services use the account\'s regular password here. If the service offers an app password, use that one. If not, use an account just for backups.
This service uses the account\'s regular password here, and it opens the whole account. Use an account just for backups.
This service does not recommend very frequent backups. With two-step verification, it may ask to approve each new location by email, and backups would stay stopped until then.
Backups stay on that service unencrypted unless encryption is turned on.
The details will be sent to %1$s. Check that it is spelled correctly.
That address is not valid. It must not include a user name, a password, ? or #
That address does not lead to a folder on that service. Check it. Nothing was saved.
The user name or password does not work
That service paused attempts for a while. It can happen after a password that did not work. Wait and try again later. Nothing was saved.
That service does not allow access to that folder. Nothing was saved.
This step failed: %1$s. That service does not work for backups. Nothing was saved.
That service points to another address. For safety, %1$s did not follow it: the password did not reach that address. Nothing was saved.
That service has no space. Nothing was saved.
That service could not be reached. Check the address and the connection. Nothing was saved.
That service took too long to answer, and the test stopped. Nothing was saved. Try again later.
The secure connection to that service could not be verified, and %1$s does not continue without it. Nothing was saved. Another option is the cloud on the phone.
Connecting the service needs internet. What was entered is kept.
Earlier backups stay in %1$s, but %2$s no longer manages them. To use them, go to Find a file.
This step is taking a while. Some services take a few minutes: the test keeps going, and it can be cancelled.
